beats.intent: The mask listens. Feet and body remain quiet.
beats.name: Attend

beats.intent: Sink into the planted feet; the mask turns before the shoulders.
beats.name: Gather

beats.intent: Unfurl the long spine; lift one paw in a measured ceremonial step.
beats.name: Ascend

beats.intent: Counter-rotate the haunch and mask. Hold the silhouette.
beats.name: Coil

beats.intent: Lead with the mask, then release the spine into a broad lateral strike.
beats.name: Sweep

beats.intent: Catch the weight with the forward paws and lower the head.
beats.name: Catch

beats.intent: Let the mantle settle as the mask regains its formal bearing.
beats.name: Recover

beats.intent: Return to the opening stance without a loop discontinuity.
beats.name: Still
